baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَجْعِهِ at word 3 names a possessed return, while لَقَادِرٌ at word 4 emphatically predicates capacity over it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return branch permits both coming back and being sent back; the capacity branch makes the subject able to restore the pronoun's referent to a prior place or state.

activation_trace.role: Return or sending back supplies the restoration event governed by the clause.
Effective capacity and control supply the agency able to accomplish that restoration.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely says that a return is possible.
changed_reading.after: The clause asserts effective control over restoring someone or something to what it had been.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction places the return under قَادِر, whose root inventory includes measure and deliberative ordering as well as power.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return becomes a bounded, proportioned operation whose extent and execution are determined, not an unstructured feat of force.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior state supplies the operation to be ordered.
Measured extent gives the return a determinate limit and proportion.
Estimation and deliberative arrangement make the return an ordered execution.

changed_reading.before: Capability means sufficient force to bring something back.
changed_reading.after: Capability includes exact command of the return's measure, timing, and arrangement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun رَجْعِهِ can denote recovery of condition, while قَادِر anchors that recovery in effective agency.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return need not be locomotion back to a place; it can restore a depleted body or condition to integrity.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of a body or animal to a better condition supplies embodied restoration.
Effective mastery makes recovery of condition executable rather than merely hoped for.

changed_reading.before: Return is movement back to an earlier location.
changed_reading.after: Return can be restoration of embodied condition to an earlier integrity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The bare noun رَجْع carries a recurrent-water branch even though the focus alone gives the pronoun no natural-process antecedent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Return can be recurrence: a governed event that comes again rather than a single backward trip.

activation_trace.role: Cyclic rain and returning water supply recurrence as a live shape of return.
Effective control supplies governance of that recurrence.

changed_reading.before: The return is a one-time reversal.
changed_reading.after: The return may be a governed recurrence whose repeated arrival displays capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated night-arriver is imaged as a strike or note and then as piercing light; the sound-repetition branch of رَجْع lets the focus become an answering signal that crosses concealment.

activation_trace.role: Repeated sound supplies the answering recurrence anchored in رَجْعِهِ.
Effective capacity governs renewal of the signal.
A rhythmically placed strike supplies the incoming beat available for return.
A single note turns the repeated طارق into a discrete audible signal.
Piercing light gives the returned signal the function of traversing darkness.

structural_cues: 86:1 and 86:2 repeat the same masculine noun before 86:3 identifies it.
The sequence moves from arrival to questioning to penetrative manifestation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, strike or note images, and piercing light; I supply the arrow from an arriving beat to an echoed or answered return. Alternatively, the opening images may establish power without specifying what رَجْعِهِ returns.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only restoration of an absent entity.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also resonate as power to renew or answer a penetrating summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: A whole self placed under guarding supplies continuity across absence; return restores an identifiable, preserved self rather than producing an unrelated replacement.

activation_trace.role: Recovery of embodied condition supplies restoration of the preserved subject.
Effective mastery makes the preserved subject's restoration achievable.
Totality makes the guarded object a whole rather than a loose remainder.
The thing itself or its identity supplies the continuity-bearing object.
Guarding supplies preservation across the interval before restoration.

structural_cues: كل نفس distributes preservation to each singular self.
86:4 places a guardian عليها, while 86:8 places capacity على رجعه.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wholeness, self-identity, and guarding; I infer that guarding preserves identity through the interval. Alternatively, the guardian may preserve only a record of deeds, not the self's constitution.

changed_reading.before: Return could manufacture an equivalent after loss.
changed_reading.after: Return recovers the same guarded identity and condition, with preservation bridging absence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation begins in reproductive water, surges, and exits from an interior; paired with sending back and ordered capacity, the first emergence becomes a trajectory that can be reversed or run again.

activation_trace.role: Return or sending back converts the prior generative trajectory into a repeatable one.
Estimation and arrangement make reconstruction a planned operation.
Measuring creation supplies a formative template that return can reinstantiate.
Reproductive water in the womb supplies the compressed origin of first emergence.
Liquid driven out in one surge supplies force and direction to generation.
Passage outside supplies the first emergence whose direction return can reverse or repeat.

structural_cues: 86:5 commands inspection of origin, 86:5-6 repeat خُلِقَ, and 86:6-7 trace motion through مِن and يخرج.
The focus immediately converts that origin sequence into a capacity claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, reproductive matter, a surge, and outward emergence; I infer that command of first emergence licenses a second by reversal or replay. Alternatively, رجع may mean return to an origin rather than reconstruction from it.

changed_reading.before: The return is an abstract future restoration.
changed_reading.after: The return is a second, exactly ordered emergence latent in the accomplished first emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return reaches an examination in which the interior becomes manifest; restoration brings the subject back into public intelligibility rather than merely back into existence.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies re-entry into an arena of examination.
Effective mastery makes restoration and exposure unavoidable.
The non-dominant mapped branch's revealing test gives return an evidentiary endpoint.
Interior concealment supplies what the returned subject had kept unavailable.
Manifestation of the secret supplies the disclosure accomplished at return.

structural_cues: 86:9 immediately follows the focus and opens a temporal scene with يوم.
Passive تُبْلَى places plural secrets under examination without renaming the agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test that manifests condition and secrets moving from concealment to exposure; I infer that return enables that disclosure. Alternatively, 86:9 may state only a later consequence.

changed_reading.after: Return restores the person into an examinable state where hidden history becomes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The capable focus subject is contrasted with a returned subject stripped of internal strength and external aid, turning capability into exclusive jurisdiction over return.

activation_trace.role: Sending back supplies the event over which agency is distributed.
Effective control supplies the positive capacity of the focus subject.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies the internal resistance negation removes.
Prevailing aid supplies the outside counter-agency negation removes.

structural_cues: 86:10 uses both فما له من and ولا to negate force and helper.
The masculine singular pronoun continues the focus's agent-patient contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive capacity and absolute negation of strength and aid; I infer an agency contrast in which return cannot be resisted or delegated away. Alternatively, helplessness may describe only the examination's aftermath.

changed_reading.before: The subject has enough power to perform a difficult act.
changed_reading.after: The subject alone controls return; the returned one has no leverage or ally able to interrupt it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky bears recurring water and fertile ground opens as growth breaks through; together they externalize return as a measured regenerative cycle in which repeated descent enables renewed emergence.

activation_trace.role: Cyclic water supplies the recurrent process anchored in رَجْعِهِ.
Deliberative proportioning supplies ordered governance of the cycle.
The overhead sky supplies the upper domain of recurring descent.
Explicit recurrent water repeats the focus noun and activates cyclical return.
Growth-bearing earth supplies the receptive body in which recurrence regenerates.
A plant splitting earth supplies renewed life emerging through closure.

structural_cues: 86:11-12 mirror السماء ذات الرجع and الأرض ذات الصدع.
The upper-lower pair creates descent, reception, rupture, and emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring water, growth-bearing earth, and a plant breaking through it; I infer that the pair models the return asserted in 86:8. Alternatively, it may only prove return by analogy while رَجْعِهِ stays personal and one-time.

changed_reading.before: Return is a single restoration detached from natural process.
changed_reading.after: Return is rendered through a repeatable ecology: recurrence from above makes enclosed life break outward again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mirrored schemes activate planning under ق د ر and reply under ر ج ع: the opposing maneuver is met by a counter-maneuver, allowing return to resonate as strategic recoil.

activation_trace.role: A returned answer supplies the counter-move by which initiative comes back.
Deliberative planning supplies strategic command rather than raw force.
Their stratagem supplies the outgoing maneuver available to be answered.
The answering stratagem supplies the counterforce that rebounds initiative.

structural_cues: 86:15-16 mirror the same verb-noun pair across plural human and singular divine subjects.
The grammatical reversal makes response structurally prominent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a scheme and formally matched counter-scheme; I supply the arrow that the response returns initiative or consequence to its source. Alternatively, this is simple outmaneuvering with no recoil sense in رَجْعِهِ.

changed_reading.before: Return concerns only the person's movement or re-creation.
changed_reading.after: Return can also name rebound of agency: a plotted act is answered and comes back upon its plotter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated commands to delay and proceed gently separate capability from immediacy; return is fully controlled because execution can be withheld, paced, and released.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the event whose timing is withheld.
Deliberative arrangement supplies control over when return executes.
Patience and absence of haste supply temporal suspension.
Gentleness and respite supply the pace at which capacity unfolds.
The non-dominant split mapping's return-to-place image links respite back to the focus event.

structural_cues: 86:17 repeats the delay command and closes with رويدا.
The surah ends in suspension rather than depicting immediate return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, gentle pace, and a split-root return image; I infer that delay belongs to sovereign scheduling of return rather than inability. Alternatively, respite may concern only punishment or plotting.

changed_reading.before: Capability suggests an act performed as soon as asserted.
changed_reading.after: Capability includes command of latency: return remains certain while deliberately deferred and paced.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the construction strongly favors returning a person or thing, not speech; valid because the focus root includes reply while 86:13-14 foreground decisive serious speech. Render only as an acoustic or judicial resonance beside bodily return, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَجْعِهِ activates the returned-answer branch, and قَادِر keeps the answer under effective command.

activation_trace.role: A returned answer supplies the verbal sense of the focus noun.
Effective control makes the answering word authoritative.
Uttered speech supplies the medium in which a reply returns.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood makes the returned word a verdict.
Non-serious speech under negation excludes a merely playful echo.

changed_reading.after: Return also resonates as answering-back: an authoritative word comes back as verdict.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the focus branch is a specialized image of reversed animal conception; valid because it belongs to رَجْعِهِ and the preceding sequence supplies reproductive water, surge, and emergence. Qualify it as a material analogy for a reversible generative threshold, not as the verse's denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَجْعِهِ activates reversed conception, while قَادِر supplies mastery over that reversal.

activation_trace.role: Failed or reversed conception supplies a specialized reproductive return.
Effective mastery controls a seemingly one-directional generative process.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the larger generative frame.
Reproductive water in the womb directly activates conception.
One-surge liquid motion supplies the passage imagined in reverse.
Emergence outside supplies the terminal direction whose reversibility is tested.

changed_reading.before: The reproductive origin only proves a later return possible.
changed_reading.after: The return also tests mastery able to reverse or reopen the generative threshold itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it joins a specialized repeated-mark branch to a non-dominant split mapping of السماء and hidden bodily lines; valid because each step is packet-backed and the focus noun licenses retracing. Render only as an analogy for recovery of an identifying pattern or record.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَجْعِهِ includes repeated visual marking, allowing return to be modeled as retracing identity rather than spatial motion.

activation_trace.role: Retraced lines supply return as visual re-inscription.
Deliberative arrangement supplies exact control of the retraced pattern.
The non-dominant split mapping's visible mark supplies identifying function.
Palm and forehead lines place a concealed personal trace among the secrets.

changed_reading.before: Return transports or rebuilds the referent as a whole object.
changed_reading.after: Return can be imagined as retracing the identifying pattern by which the referent becomes legible again.

strongest_changes: Creation and emergence turn generic restoration into a second, measured emergence latent in the first.
Guarding followed by testing makes return preserve identity and expose hidden history.
The exact contextual recurrence of رَجْع renders return as a water-to-emergence cycle.
Negated human force and later respite distinguish exclusive capability from immediate execution.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots sustained coexisting material, temporal, ecological, forensic, acoustic, and strategic mechanisms. Especially productive were the exact contextual recurrence of رَجْع, measure and planning around قَادِر, and non-dominant split mappings that linked disclosure or delay back to return.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedents and agent-patient relation of the masculine pronouns remain compressed; some models may describe return's mode without identifying its referent.
Measure and planning are root-branch activations around قَادِر and are less morphologically direct than effective capacity.
The acoustic, conception-reversal, strategic-recoil, and retraced-identity readings are analogical resonances, not replacements for restoration.
